name: HBM Nigeria Plc (formerly Lafarge Africa)
source: CRON 20261014: HBM Nigeria Plc (NGX ticker WAPCO, formerly Lafarge Africa) unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the six months ended 30 June 2026, Group column (NGX doclib filing library), printed in thousands of naira and scaled to naira. Revenue 678,410,621 less the printed cost of sales 256,595,346 equals the printed gross profit 421,815,275. Operating expenses are the printed selling and distribution costs 85,572,600 plus the printed administrative expenses 45,452,839; gross profit less those plus the printed other income 329,450 less the printed impairment expense 175,623 equals the printed operating profit 290,943,663. Net finance costs are the printed finance costs 1,159,822 less the printed finance income 27,947,762, so negative. Operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed profit before tax 317,731,603 and less the printed income tax 109,384,953 equals the printed profit after tax 208,346,650. Basic earnings per share stored in naira from the printed 1,293 kobo. | AfricanFinancials (audited summary) | CRON 2026-10-06: 2 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/WAPCO/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie.
